notes.title: Update V2.3.0
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where the turret still rotates when paused
2. Fixed the bug where the encyclopedia could not be fully unlocked after completing the exploration mode
3. Fixed the bug where mutated joints could not be replaced normally
4. Fixed the bug where the bounty in disaster mode may be settled twice
5. Increased the range of machine gun turrets
6. Slightly increased the minimum cooldown time for enemies
7. Performance optimization was carried out in several places

notes.title: Update V2.2.10
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that caused the small fish to generate wings before upgrading the wings due to the mutation feature "flying fish"
2. Adjusted the display hierarchy of some images
3. Fixed bug where self destructing fish would not be affected by shock waves

notes.title: Update V2.2.9
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where some fish's split joints did not work

notes.title: Update V2.2.8
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where the player was caught by a squid head and did not exit the captured state properly, resulting in the character being unable to move
2. Increased the minimum survival time for corals

notes.title: Update V2.2.7
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where the combination of power extraction and joint replication would cause attribute increase to become permanent
2. In the betting interface of disaster mode, addition and subtraction in units of 10 have been added
3. Adjust the disaster mode so that bets will only be deducted when the game officially starts

notes.title: Update V2.1.11
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where the exploration mode lake level could not be completed properly
2. Added scene object: mines

notes.title: Update V2.1.10
notes.notes:
1. The time interval of lightning events increases randomly
2. After completing the first four levels in exploration mode, unlock classic mode, but unlocking more maps requires completing the corresponding exploration mode levels
3. Adjusted the display of the organ position interface
4. Added dizziness and electric shock effects

notes.title: Update V2.1.9
notes.notes:
1. Weakened the reactive force received during a stab attack
2. The position of the fruit generated by the tree increases randomly
3. Slightly increase the cooling time of parasitic straws when switching hosts
4. Overlord new skill, Fury: within 10 seconds, cooldown time is 0, and movement speed is accelerated
5. Slightly increase the minimum cooling time for generating toxic fog on the buttocks
6. Fixed the bug where Abyss Mouth would deduct a little more life recovery
7. Increased the upgrade speed of the dominant enemy

notes.title: Update V2.1.8
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where the mutation option was disabled, sometimes leading to incorrect disabling of mutation joints
2. Optimized for some special effects

notes.title: Update V2.1.7
notes.notes:
1. Power jet mutation can now extend the range of spores
2. Fixed the issue where the small fish generated by the ovaries did not match the player's fish body
3. The maximum size of small fish generated by ovaries will not exceed half of the player's size
4. Slightly increased the maximum rotation amplitude of the rotating joint
5. Increased the maximum health of the warship

notes.title: Update V2.1.6
notes.notes:
1. Added attributes and upgrade speed for overlord enemies
2. Compressed the image size

notes.title: Update V2.1.5
notes.notes:
1. The small fish generated by the ovaries will immediately begin to mutate after upgrading the population mutation
2. Adjust the generation of meat chunks to increase larger ones

notes.title: Update V2.1.4
notes.notes:
1. Now squid heads can bite enemies of the same size as themselves
2. Fixed the bug that lightning Horn cannot attack self destructing fish
3. Reduced the time required to persist in some exploration mode levels
4. Optimized the performance of the toxic mist

notes.title: Update V2.1.3
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where sometimes enemies die without shedding meat chunks

notes.title: Update V2.1.2
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where meat chunks were easily eaten by other fish when activated
2. Fixed the issue where the disabled button cannot be used normally when pressed with the controller
3. Added a fade in animation for the game ending UI
4. Reduced the amplitude of character hit animations

notes.title: Update V2.1.1
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where small fish generated by ovaries can cause damage to players when equipped with praying mantis knives
2. Optimized the number of meat pieces in the scene
3. Characteristics adjustment of zombie fish: Swallowing radioactive substances will not cause harm to oneself
4. Adjustment: The small fish generated by the ovaries will reset their position when they are too far away from the player
5. Fixed a bug where a certain number of variant features were not displayed in the UI
6. Adjustment: Enemies with a smaller body size than the player's will no longer cause dizziness in their equipment's eyes
7. Adjustment: Only the shock wave when the boss enemy dies will stun the player, while the shock wave when other enemies die will not.
8. Add records of character body color and the amount of radiation swallowed to the game information stored in the exhibition hall

notes.title: Update V2.1.0
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where the calculation of the rotation speed of large enemies was incorrect, causing them to move away from players in the later stages
2. Performance optimization was carried out for the later spores
3. Optimized and reduced the reactive force on character melee attacks

notes.title: Update V2.0.9
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue of incorrect display of variant organ names
2. Extended the interval time for generating enemy bosses in the later stage
3. Fixed the issue of wings not updating size when equipping
3. Performance optimization: Limited the maximum quantity of meat chunks and corals

notes.title: Update V2.0.7
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where the small fish equipment generated by the ovaries would target players after tracking spores
2. Fixed the bug where the laser of the mutated lizard head cannot attack ships and self destructing fish
3. Corrected the problem of beach terrain being too difficult to destroy
4. Fixed the issue of incorrect display of exhibition hall information
5. Fixed the issue of unable to enter the game normally from the exhibition hall

notes.title: Update V2.0.6
notes.notes:
1. Fixed UI adaptation issues for long proportion screens
2. Fixed the issue of controller operation failure in the classic mode map selection UI

notes.title: Update V2.0.5
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where tracking spores would attack our own small fish
2. Fixed bug where incorrect number of gene fragments were returned when revoking gene upgrades
